title: Canonical Proposal
description: Compact immutable proposal for the AdCP 3.2 lifecycle. commercial_terms is the sole authoritative commercial envelope; narrative fields do not duplicate legacy allocation or creative graphs.

parent_proposal_id.description: Immediate predecessor this snapshot was forked from. Every proposal produced by refine_proposals carries it, equal to the request's source proposal_id, so negotiation lineage is reconstructible from proposals alone.

opportunity_id.description: Buyer planning cycle associated with this proposal. Revisions inherit it; it does not participate in proposal identity.

proposal_status.description: draft is indicative and unreserved; committed has firm terms with inventory reserved until expires_at; accepted is the historical snapshot attached to a MediaBuy.

expires_at.description: For a draft, the indicative-terms freshness deadline. For a committed proposal, the inventory-hold deadline under inventory_hold semantics, or the acceptance-window deadline under terms_only semantics (get_adcp_capabilities media_buy.proposal_refinement.hold_semantics, or hold_policy.available false).

hold_policy.description: Experimental (media_buy.hold_policy). On a draft, the binding policy for a successful finalize of this draft, derived by the seller from the allocated products when it created the draft: available is false if any allocated product's effective policy is non-holdable, min_duration and max_duration do not exceed the max_duration of any allocated product that declares one, max_total_duration does not exceed that of any allocated product that declares one, and extendable is true only if every allocated product is extendable. Product values are planning hints; the immutable draft governs finalize even if a product's policy changes. On a committed proposal, the seller carries the draft's policy forward unchanged; it governs the hold finalize placed, including extension limits, and each extend_hold successor carries it forward unchanged. A seller that lists media_buy.hold_policy MUST include it on every draft and committed proposal it returns to a caller at 3.3 or later, and MUST omit it for callers below 3.3. When absent, get_adcp_capabilities media_buy.proposal_refinement.hold_semantics applies.

hold_placed_at.description: Experimental (media_buy.hold_policy). When the seller placed this committed proposal's hold, which is when it created the committed proposal. Required on a committed proposal whose hold_policy.available is true; forbidden on drafts and when hold_policy.available is false. It MUST be no earlier than when the seller received the finalize request and no later than the synchronous response or, for a submitted finalize, the task's completion. hold_placed_at plus hold_policy.min_duration MUST NOT be later than expires_at, and expires_at MUST NOT be later than hold_placed_at plus hold_policy.max_duration. An exact retry returns the original hold_placed_at and expires_at; it never restarts the clock. Each extend_hold successor carries it forward unchanged, so extension never restarts the max_total_duration clock. Omitted, with hold_policy, for callers below 3.3.

terms_digest.description: Base64url SHA-256 digest of the RFC 8785 JCS serialization of commercial_terms, prefixed with sha256:.

total_budget_guidance.description: Optional budget guidance for this proposal — the planning answer to criteria.outcome_target and to open-budget briefs. commercial_terms.total_budget remains the concrete figure the plan is priced at; this band expresses the seller's recommended range around it. When criteria.outcome_target carries cost_per, the cost answer is commercial_terms.bidding.cost_per and this band's currency equals cost_per.currency.

forecast.description: Aggregate forecasted delivery for the proposal. For outcome_target requests, points carry the goal's metric or event key in metrics, or for a vendor_metric goal in vendor_metric_values[] plus metrics.spend; with cost_per, that is the goal volume planned under the commercial_terms.bidding policy, and currency equals cost_per.currency.

allOf.description: A committed proposal that holds inventory records when the hold was placed.
hold_placed_at describes a placed hold, so it needs a hold_policy that holds and a non-draft proposal.
